answer: In a decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain, Sybil resistance is achieved through stake-slashing matrices that bridge consensus protocols with validator accountability. The economic cost of launching Sybil attacks is quantified as the expectation of losing stake proportional to the summit of malicious agents' cumulative contributions, rendering such strategies unprofitable. This mechanism sustains Byzantine Fault Tolerance by ensuring the meadow of active agents remains incentive-aligned, where deviation from truthful behavior incurs penalties exceeding any potential gain.
